label: Stop (止まれ / STOP)
meaning: Come to a complete stop at the designated stopping point.
visualDescription: Red inverted triangle with white center and Japanese 止まれ, sometimes with STOP below.
shortAlert: Stop before the stop line, or before the intersection if there is no line.
explanation: Come to a complete stop at the stop line, or immediately before the intersection when no line is present.
conditions: Stop at the designated stopping point.

label: Stop
meaning: Come to a complete stop at the stop line.
visualDescription: Red octagon with a white border and the word STOP in white.
shortAlert: Stop at the designated stop line.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies the STOP sign as requiring the driver to stop at the designated stop line.
conditions: Stop at the designated stop line.

label: No Entry
meaning: Vehicles must not enter from this direction.
visualDescription: Red circular disc with a horizontal white bar.
shortAlert: Do not enter from this direction.
explanation: This sign prohibits vehicle entry from this direction.
conditions: Applies to entry from the signed direction.

label: No Entry
officialName: No entry for all types of vehicle
meaning: Vehicles must not enter.
visualDescription: White circular sign with red border and diagonal slash, with NO ENTRY text or a vehicle symbol.
shortAlert: No entry for vehicles.
explanation: The LTO manual lists this as no entry for all types of vehicle.
conditions: Applies where posted.

label: Maximum speed 40 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed the displayed maximum speed.
visualDescription: White circle with red border and black 40 numerals.
shortAlert: Maximum speed is 40 kilometers per hour.
explanation: The displayed number specifies the maximum permitted speed.
conditions: The numeric value varies by sign.

label: Maximum speed 40 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed the displayed maximum speed.
visualDescription: White circle with red border and black 40 numerals, often paired with SPEED LIMIT wording.
shortAlert: Maximum speed is 40 kilometers per hour.
explanation: The LTO manual classifies this sign as a maximum speed restriction.
conditions: The numeric value varies by sign.

label: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: A pedestrian crossing is present; give way to pedestrians.
visualDescription: Blue sign with a white walking-person symbol.
shortAlert: Pedestrian crossing. Be ready to stop and give way.
explanation: At pedestrian crossings, stop and give way when pedestrians are crossing or about to cross.
conditions: Applies at the marked crossing.

label: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: A pedestrian crossing is ahead or present.
visualDescription: Yellow diamond warning sign with black walking-person symbol and optional PED XING words.
shortAlert: Pedestrian crossing ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing.
explanation: This warning sign indicates a pedestrian crossing area.
conditions: Watch for pedestrians at the crossing.

label: No Parking
meaning: Parking is prohibited.
visualDescription: Blue circle with red border and one red diagonal slash.
shortAlert: Parking is not permitted here.
explanation: The sign prohibits parking of vehicles.
conditions: Applies within the signed restriction.

label: No Parking
meaning: Parking is prohibited.
visualDescription: White rectangular sign with red NO PARKING text or a crossed P symbol.
shortAlert: No parking where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists No Parking among parking and stopping signs.
conditions: Check any schedule or supplementary plate.

label: No U-turn
meaning: U-turns are prohibited.
visualDescription: Blue circle with a white U-turn arrow crossed by a red slash.
shortAlert: U-turns are not permitted.
explanation: Vehicles must not make a U-turn where this sign applies.
conditions: Applies where posted.

label: No U-turn
meaning: U-turns are prohibited.
visualDescription: White circle with red border and slash over a black U-turn arrow, sometimes with text.
shortAlert: Do not make a U-turn here.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies this sign as prohibiting U-turns.
conditions: Applies where posted.

label: Slow (徐行 / SLOW)
meaning: Proceed slowly enough to stop immediately.
visualDescription: Red inverted triangle with white center and Japanese 徐行, sometimes with SLOW below.
shortAlert: Proceed slowly and be able to stop immediately.
explanation: This Japanese regulatory sign requires vehicles and streetcars to slow down.
conditions: Applies where posted.

label: Use of Horn
meaning: Sound the horn at the designated place or section.
visualDescription: Blue circular sign with a white horn symbol.
shortAlert: Sound the horn where this sign requires it.
explanation: Japan designates places and signed road sections where vehicles must sound their horn.
conditions: Supplementary signs may define the section.

label: Moped two-stage right turn
officialName: Method for Motorized Bicycles to Turn Right (in Two Stages)
meaning: Motorized bicycles must make a two-stage right turn.
visualDescription: Blue circular sign with a white staged right-turn arrow and moped context.
shortAlert: Motorized bicycles must use the designated two-stage right turn.
explanation: This sign specifies the two-stage method for motorized bicycles turning right.
conditions: Applies to the vehicle category shown.

label: Priority road ahead
meaning: The intersecting road ahead has priority.
visualDescription: Red inverted triangle with Japanese text indicating the road ahead has priority.
shortAlert: The intersecting road ahead has priority.
explanation: This Japanese sign indicates that the road intersecting ahead has priority.
conditions: A supplementary plate may be present.

label: Road closed without tire chains
officialName: Road Closed to Vehicles without Tire Chains
meaning: Vehicles without tire chains must not enter.
visualDescription: Blue circular restriction sign depicting a tire fitted with a chain.
shortAlert: This road is closed to vehicles without tire chains.
explanation: The Japanese regulatory sign closes the road to vehicles not equipped with tire chains.
conditions: Applies where posted.

label: No Jeepneys
meaning: Jeepneys must not enter.
visualDescription: White circular restriction sign with red border and slash over a jeepney silhouette.
shortAlert: Jeepneys must not enter where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists a vehicle-specific no-entry sign for jeepneys.
conditions: Applies to jeepneys where posted.

label: No Tricycles
meaning: Tricycles must not enter.
visualDescription: White circular restriction sign with red border and slash over a motorized tricycle silhouette.
shortAlert: Tricycles must not enter where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists a vehicle-specific no-entry sign for tricycles.
conditions: Applies to tricycles where posted.

label: No Pushcarts
meaning: Pushcarts must not enter.
visualDescription: White circular restriction sign with red border and slash over a hand-pushed cart symbol.
shortAlert: Pushcarts must not enter where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists a vehicle-specific no-entry sign for pushcarts.
conditions: Applies to pushcarts where posted.

label: No Animal-drawn Vehicles
meaning: Animal-drawn vehicles must not enter.
visualDescription: White circular restriction sign with red border and slash over a horse-and-cart symbol.
shortAlert: Animal-drawn vehicles must not enter where this sign applies.
explanation: The LTO manual lists a vehicle-specific no-entry sign for animal-drawn vehicles.
conditions: Applies to animal-drawn vehicles where posted.

label: BUS–PUJ Stop
meaning: Designated stopping zone for buses and public utility jeepneys.
visualDescription: Rectangular text sign naming BUS–PUJ STOP, commonly with arrows or zone information.
shortAlert: Designated bus and public utility jeepney stop zone.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies a BUS–PUJ STOP among parking and stopping signs.
conditions: Follow posted arrows, times, and zone limits.

label: Railway crossing ahead (踏切あり)
meaning: A railway crossing is ahead.
visualDescription: Japanese diamond warning sign with a railway or train symbol.
shortAlert: Railway crossing ahead. Check the crossing and follow its signals.
explanation: This is an advance warning of a level crossing, not a statement that the vehicle is already at the tracks.
conditions: The sign warns of a level crossing ahead.
exceptions: At a crossing equipped with traffic lights, follow the lights.

label: No right turn
meaning: Vehicles must not turn right where the sign applies.
visualDescription: White circular sign with red border and slash over a black right-turn arrow.
shortAlert: No right turn at this sign.
explanation: The LTO manual identifies this as the general NO RIGHT TURN prohibition.
conditions: Applies where posted.
